greek_apparatus_control.finding: 11:13 apparatus reports omission of the Cainan life paragraph in E* and presence in the margin by E-a; key identifies E as Codex Bodleianus, original writing by *, later correction by a. This reported omission has specific boundaries and does not by itself demonstrate absence of Cainan's name from every preceding clause.

greek_apparatus_control.additional_key: Swete printed xxvi/PDF30 identifies E and its correction labels; consulted visually.
greek_apparatus_control.scope: Printed edition reports, not fresh manuscript inspection; Swete and Brooke-McLean are not independent witness votes
